import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = (int)1e9;
    static final int MAXN = 15;
    static final int MAXT = 65;
    static char[][] s1 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] s2 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] dp = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[][][] idx = new int[MAXT][MAXN][MAXN];
    static int cur = 1;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long cap, flow;
        Edge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int N;
        ArrayList<Edge> E;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> g;
        int[] d, pt;

        Dinic(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            E = new ArrayList<>();
            g = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            d = new int[N];
            pt = new int[N];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            if (u == v) return;
            Edge e1 = new Edge(u, v, cap);
            Edge e2 = new Edge(v, u, 0);
            g.get(u).add(E.size());
            E.add(e1);
            g.get(v).add(E.size());
            E.add(e2);
        }

        boolean bfs(int S, int T) {
            Arrays.fill(d, N + 1);
            d[S] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(S);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == T) break;
                for (int idx : g.get(u)) {
                    Edge e = E.get(idx);
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && d[e.v] > d[e.u] + 1) {
                        d[e.v] = d[e.u] + 1;
                        q.add(e.v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[T] != N + 1;
        }

        long dfs(int u, int T, long flow) {
            if (u == T || flow == 0) return flow;
            for (int i = pt[u]; i < g.get(u).size(); i++) {
                Edge e = E.get(g.get(u).get(i));
                Edge oe = E.get(g.get(u).get(i) ^ 1);
                if (d[e.v] == d[e.u] + 1) {
                    long amt = e.cap - e.flow;
                    if (flow != -1 && amt > flow) amt = flow;
                    long pushed = dfs(e.v, T, amt);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        oe.flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
                pt[u]++;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow(int S, int T) {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs(S, T)) {
                Arrays.fill(pt, 0);
                long flow;
                while ((flow = dfs(S, T, Long.MAX_VALUE)) > 0)
                    total += flow;
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                s1[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        for (int time = 0; time <= t + 1; time++)
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                    idx[time][i][j] = cur++;

        int source = 0, sink = cur;
        cur++;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                s2[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        // BFS from 'Z'
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Arrays.fill(dp[i], -1);
        int[][] q = new int[225][2];
        int qh = 0, qt = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q[qt][0] = i;
                    q[qt][1] = j;
                    qt++;
                    dp[i][j] = 0;
                }
        while (qh < qt) {
            int uy = q[qh][0], ux = q[qh][1];
            qh++;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int vy = uy + dy[d], vx = ux + dx[d];
                if (vy >= 1 && vy <= n && vx >= 1 && vx <= n && s1[vy][vx] != 'Y' && dp[vy][vx] == -1) {
                    dp[vy][vx] = dp[uy][ux] + 1;
                    q[qt][0] = vy;
                    q[qt][1] = vx;
                    qt++;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                if (dp[i][j] == -1 || dp[i][j] > t) dp[i][j] = INF;

        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(cur);
        // source edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                if (s1[i][j] >= '1' && s1[i][j] <= '9')
                    dinic.addEdge(source, idx[0][i][j], s1[i][j] - '0');

        // time edges
        for (int x = 0; x < t; x++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                    if (s1[i][j] == 'Y' || s1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int vy = i + dy[d], vx = j + dx[d];
                        if (vy >= 1 && vy <= n && vx >= 1 && vx <= n && s1[vy][vx] != 'Y' && s1[vy][vx] != 'Z') {
                            if (dp[vy][vx] >= x + 1 && dp[i][j] > x)
                                dinic.addEdge(idx[x][i][j], idx[x + 1][vy][vx], 1000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // sink edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Y' || s1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                if (s2[i][j] >= '1' && s2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int cap = s2[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int x = 0; x <= t; x++)
                        dinic.addEdge(idx[x][i][j], idx[t + 1][i][j], cap);
                    dinic.addEdge(idx[t + 1][i][j], sink, cap);
                }
            }

        System.out.println(dinic.maxFlow(source, sink));
    }
}
